description: This file defines the SerialPortReader class which implements the SerialPortEventListener interface to handle serial port events, read incoming data, and notify a DataListener.

classes.name: SerialPortReader
classes.description: A class that listens for serial port events, reads incoming data, and forwards it to a DataListener.

methods.name: SerialPortReader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SerialPortReader with a specific serial port and data listener.

methods.name: serialEvent
methods.description: Handles serial port events, invoking data reading methods if conditions are met.

methods.name: handleRx
methods.description: Reads incoming bytes from the serial port, converts them to a string, and passes them to the data listener.
